topic: Fourier Series Decomposition via Rotating Epicycles

wave.derived: last 500 y-values of the epicycle tip, forming the output waveform

srtc.R: A chain of rotating circles (epicycles), each at a frequency proportional to its harmonic index. A dot traces the tip, and its y-position is recorded to draw the reconstructed square wave on the right. A dashed line connects the tip to the wave.
srtc.T: Play/Pause button starts or freezes the rotation. The harmonic slider adds or removes outer epicycles in odd increments, immediately reshaping the output wave and its sharpness.
srtc.C: As n_harmonics increases toward infinity, the reconstructed wave converges to a perfect square wave, demonstrating Fourier's theorem that any periodic signal decomposes into sinusoids.
